name: Dynamic Block Enhancer
author: Brian Keary

sections.description:
A simple, lightweight WordPress plugin for displaying a call out bar anywhere you would like it to show.

The Dynamic Block Enhancer plugin creates a call-out box at the top, bottom or 3 paragraphs down on pages, posts, post types, or taxonomies. You can put anything you want in the boxes including HTML and/or shortcodes. You can schedule each call-out box to show on a specific date or turn off on a specific date. The number of call-out boxes is limitless.

Feel free to try out the plugin through our installation of Dynamic Block Enhancer.

Troubleshooting: This works with Gutenberg and Divi. Functionality for Bricks and Elementor coming soon.
sections.installation:
Add the plugin by uploading the zip file to your WordPress admin area > Plugins > Add New or by installing it from the WordPress Plugin directory.
Activate the plugin and go to Settings > Dynamic Blocks.
Configure it as you would like.
Save.
That’s all!

short_description: A plugin to inject dynamic content/tips into posts/pages with category/tag overrides, scheduling, and random rotation.
